capabilities: Display a floating toolbar above selected text in the editor
Apply heading levels, bold, italic, strikethrough, and highlight formatting
Wrap selection in links, wikilinks, inline code, code blocks, or comments
Convert selection to bullet, numbered, or checkbox lists and blockquotes
Show or hide individual toolbar buttons in settings
extras: The README includes a permissions note stating the plugin writes to the clipboard for Copy/Cut but never reads from it; the manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The Credits section is empty.
problem: Obsidian's editor has no selection toolbar, so applying common formatting requires remembering keyboard shortcuts or going through the command palette.
summary: Floating toolbar that appears above selected text with one-click Markdown formatting actions such as headings, bold, highlight, links, and lists.
